rows.en:
Well, I was wondering if you'd want to go out
to the artificial island with me this weekend...

The artificial island...?
Why would I go somewhere like that with you...

Now if you were some cute girlie,
that'd be another story...
(...Figures...)
rows.notes: Male only; shared with Hilda invitation scenes (frd_hld_101-106).

rows.en:
Yes, I was wondering if you'd want to go out
to the artificial island with me this weekend...
rows.notes: Female (Gary); also male in frd_hld_106. Neutral.

rows.en:
Now if you were a grown-up babe with a nice bod,
that'd be another story...
(Jeez! How rude!)

Well, I was wondering if you'd want to go
to "199" with me this weekend...
rows.notes: Male only. Shop name in double quotes, as in earlier slices.

rows.en:
"199"...?
Why would I go somewhere like that with you...

Yes, I was wondering if you'd want to go
to "199" with me this weekend...
rows.notes: Female (Gary); also male in frd_hld_105. Neutral.

rows.en:
Well, I was wondering if you'd want to go see
the Battle Frontier with me this weekend...

Yes, I was wondering if you'd want to go see
the Battle Frontier with me this weekend...
rows.notes: Female (Gary); both genders in frd_hld_108. Neutral.

rows.en:
(Okay, that's it for classes...
Maybe I'll try talking to Gary-sensei...)
Excuse me, Gary-sensei, are you free after this?

Hm, it's \p, huh?
Sorry, after this I've got a thing with some ladies...
y'know...

So yeah, that's how it is.
Don't let this put you off. Ask me again sometime.
Okay. Sorry to bother you.
rows.notes: Shared by Gary and Hilda scenes, both genders; neutral.

rows.en: (A thing with some ladies...)

(Okay, that's it for classes...
Maybe I'll try talking to Gary-sensei...)
Some ladies...
(A thing with some ladies... Jeez!)

(Now, my plans for this weekend...
Maybe I'll invite Gary-sensei to Griffith Park...
How about that?)
Hm, it's \p. What's up?
rows.notes: Shared by Gary and Hilda invitation scenes; neutral.

rows.en:
Yes, I was thinking maybe we could spend
this weekend together at Griffith Park...

Griffith Park...
Hmm, well, a place like that might be nice
once in a while, but...
Oh, then...

Ahh, but dang it...
This weekend I've... kinda got a thing...
Oh, I see. Sorry to bother you.
rows.notes: Shared by Gary and Hilda scenes; neutral.

rows.en: (Well, maybe next time...)
rows.notes: Male only; Gary and Hilda scenes.

rows.en:
(Now, my plans for this weekend...
Maybe I'll invite Gary-sensei to Griffith Park...
How does that sound?)
(Well, maybe... next time...)
rows.notes: Female only; Gary and Hilda scenes.

rows.en:
(Now, my plans for this weekend...
Maybe I'll invite Gary-sensei to a concert
at the Sky Gate...)

Yes, I was thinking maybe we could go
to a concert at the Sky Gate this weekend...
A concert, huh... Not bad...
So, then...
rows.notes: Shared by Gary and Hilda scenes; neutral.

rows.en:
But... this weekend's concert is
"Kiichiro Tokugawa," right...
I've got zero interest in that...
rows.notes: Both genders. Singer name not in the glossary; romanized, given name first.

rows.en: (Yeah, enka was probably asking too much...)
rows.notes: Male only. Enka: the singer is evidently an enka act.

rows.en: (Enka was a no-go after all...)

(Now, my plans for this weekend...
Maybe I'll invite Gary-sensei shopping
in Deep Akihabara...)
rows.notes: Both genders. Deep Akihabara is provisional in the glossary.

rows.en:
Yes, I was thinking maybe we could go
shopping in Deep Akihabara this weekend...

Deep Akihabara, huh...
Not bad at all. It's a place you never get tired of...

(Now, my plans for this weekend...
Maybe I'll invite Gary-sensei to Nyan-Nyan...)

Yes, I was thinking maybe we could
grab a meal at Nyan-Nyan this weekend...

What? You trying to mooch off me?
Well, I guess that's not so bad once in a while...

(Now, my plans for this weekend...
Maybe the artificial island with Gary-sensei...)

Yes, I was wondering, how about
the artificial island this weekend...

Oh~!
You're starting to get it! That's right,
on your days off, it's vacation, full blast!

Come out right now, or I'll shear the mane
off that precious horse of yours!
rows.notes: Hilda (frd_gyr_009/010); same line as c05502 without the break.

rows.en: (It's nice to talk with a teacher once in a while...)
Hey, \p. Sorry to keep you waiting.
No, I just got here.
rows.notes: Shared by several Hilda scenes; neutral.

rows.en: I see. Then let's get started right away.
What?! Get started with what...

Asking me to coach your 'self-training.'
That's the right attitude. No time to dawdle.
We'll start with stretches.
Uh... um...

Don't 'uh, um' me!
Where's your answer?

Good, that's an answer!
First, loosen up properly. If your body isn't
warmed up, it's easy to get hurt.
rows.notes: Both genders. The player's reply is off-screen.

rows.en:
Listen, the basic rule of stretching is 'Hurts-Good.'
Remember that. Bend to where it only 'hurts'
and all you'll do is injure yourself.

'It hurts, but it feels good.' Stay within that
and gradually widen your joints' range of motion.
Got it?!

Yes, understood.
Hup...

What, are you playing around?
Come on, reach! You can bend further than that!
Ah, Hilda-sensei, it hurts! I can't!

Don't be ridiculous!
This doesn't even count as stretching!
(Didn't she say 'Hurts-Good' a minute ago...)
Ow ow ow... everything hurts...

Alright, that's probably enough stretching.
Next, running. Twenty laps of the schoolyard!
Wh... Twenty laps...

And when that's done, it's strength training!
No dawdling. Focus on how your muscles move!
Go on, get running!
(...N-no way...)

Alright, let's call it a day.
But are you even taking my classes seriously?
Honestly, I dread to think what's ahead...
Yes, from now on I'll focus and work hard in class!
Mm. Good answer. See you.
(Phew, never thought it'd turn out like this...)
(It's nice to talk with a teacher once in a while...)
No, I only just got here, so...
rows.notes: Female in several Hilda scenes; male in frd_hld_007. Neutral.

rows.en:
Yes, understood.
Heave-ho...
Ah, Hilda-sensei, it... kinda hurts! I can't!
(She said 'Hurts-Good' just a minute ago...)
Owww... my whole body hurts...
Um... twenty laps...

c05596: 'henji wa dou shita?' (where is your reply?) rendered 'Where's your answer?'; the player's reply is not shown (c05597 'yoshi, ii henji da').
c05555/c05558/c05560/c05561: Gary's 'oneechan-tachi' rendered 'some ladies' and echoed by the player.
c05579-c05581: Deep Akihabara is 'provisional' in the glossary.
c05575 ('e, sore jaa') rendered 'So, then...' and c05566 ('a, sore jaa') 'Oh, then...' to keep the two apart.
